master_claims.text: The chair has a high, rounded back
The chair has integrated curved arms
The chair features vertical channel stitching
The chair has a separate rectangular seat cushion
The chair rests on a white five-spoke wheeled base
The wheeled base has black-and-white casters
A desk is positioned behind the chair
A laptop is positioned behind the chair
The chair is upholstered in white
A separate rectangular white cushion is placed against the backrest
A black adjustment lever extends beneath the seat on the left side

edit_log: Retained all original claims because each received a NOVEL redundancy verdict

parsed.final_alt_text: The chair has a high, rounded back and integrated curved arms, with vertical channel stitching and a separate rectangular seat cushion. The chair is upholstered in white, with a separate rectangular white cushion placed against the backrest, and rests on a white five-spoke wheeled base with black-and-white casters; a black adjustment lever extends beneath the seat on the left side. A desk and laptop are positioned behind the chair.
